usageNotes: Use this to install a custom TLS certificate (and optionally its private key) on a PDM node, replacing the self-signed certificate used by the web UI. The `certificates` field must contain the full PEM chain (leaf + intermediates); if a cert already exists, set `force: true` to overwrite. Returns immediately with the new certificate info — there is no async UPID, but the UI will reflect the change on next reload.

examples.summary: Upload a Let's Encrypt cert chain and private key to the local PDM node

params.certificates:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIF...leaf cert...==
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIF...intermediate...==
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
params.key:
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIE...private key...==
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----

tips: The `restart` param is documented as a UI compatibility shim and has no effect — omit it.
If uploading a chain, order matters: leaf certificate first, then intermediates.
Omitting `key` leaves the existing private key in place, which is valid only when re-uploading a renewed cert for the same key pair.
Requires the `System.Modify` privilege on the calling token/user — API tokens scoped only to specific nodes will be rejected.
